item.title: Root isolation for analytic functions using cubic hermite interpolation
item.description: arXiv:2610.02934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a root isolation algorithm for an analytic function. The method combines interval subdivision with a heuristic test based on local cubic Hermite interpolation. Whenever the function is sufficiently close to its cubic Hermite interpolant at a few sample points, we assume that the critical points of the cubic interpolant give a valid root isolation for the original function. Such an algorithm cannot, in general, provide a rigorous certification of the computed intervals. Nevertheless, extensive numerical experiments show that it is highly efficient and almost always produces the correct results. We hope that a probabilistic or exact algorithm can be derived from this work.
item.dc:creator: Christophe Raffalli (GAATI)

item.title: Fast matrix multiplication via recursive $\langle$ 4x4x4:48 $\rangle$ algorithms into practice
item.description: arXiv:2609.12027v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a fast algorithm for multiplying two 4x4 matrices using 48 multiplications and 204 other operations (addition, subtraction or scaling by a constant) over any ring containing an inverse of 2. Applied recursively, this algorithm reaches a cost bound with leading term (7+3/8)n^{\log_4(48)}. Alternative basis decompositions of this algorithm further reduce this to (6+13/32)n^{\log_4(48)}, with square change of bases, and then to (5+2/3)n^{\log_4(48)}, using rectangular encodings with inner dimensions 24 and 32. The conversion costs of these alternative basis variants are included as lower-order terms.
item.dc:creator: Jean-Guillaume Dumas (UGA LJK CASC), Cl\'ement Pernet (CASC), Alexandre Sedoglavic (CRIStAL), Joshua Stapleton, Petr Tichavsk\'y

item.title: Comprehensive Restriction Algorithm for Hypergeometric Systems
item.description: arXiv:2510.05104v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: An algorithm computing the restriction of a holonomic D-module to a linear subspace was given by T.Oaku in 1997. We consider a problem of computing the restriction for a given holonomic D-module with parameters. We will give a partial answer to the problem for general holonomic D-modules and an answer to hypergeometric holonomic D-modules. The above results are based on comprehensive Groebner system and an algorithm for the isomorphic classification of hypergeometric D-modules.
item.dc:creator: Hiromasa Nakayama, Nobuki Takayama
